product_metadata.title: iDesign Classico Metal 8-Loop Scarf Hanger, No Snag Closet Organization Storage Holder for Scarves, Men's Ties, Women's Shawls, Pashminas, Belts, Accessories, Clothes, 13.13" x .5" x 1.25", Chrome
features: FUNCTIONAL ACCESSORY HANGER: Scarf hanger features 8 snag-free, continuous loops. Hang scarves, belts, jewelry, shawls, pashminas, ties, socks, delicates, outerwear, and more! Great for use in bedroom closets, mudroom, college dorms, apartments, and offices
EASY INSTALLATION: No hardware required - simply hang over closet rod or hook!
DURABLE METAL: Made of durable, rust-resistant steel for years of quality use
STYLISH: Shiny chrome finish looks great with any decor style
IDEAL SIZE: Compact hanger measures 13.13" x .5" x 1.25" to fit in any closet
description: The iDesign Classico 8 Loop Scarf Hanger helps keep scarves and ties organized and easy to find! This closet organizer requires no assembly - simply put your favorite accessories through the snag-free loops and hang over any closet rod or hook. Made of durable steel with a chrome finish, this hanger includes 8 loops to store scarves, ties, belts, pashminas and more. Keep your accessories organized while also maximizing your closet space! Hanging rack measures 13.13" x .5" x 1.25", the perfect size for your closet. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
